structured_output.what_is_happening: DAH ("Dinosaurs And Humans") is about 16 minutes old. It was created about 3 seconds before its PumpSwap pool (created_unix 1790410676, pool 08:17:59Z). It is not a pump.fun curve graduate (migrated_unix=0, no launchpad), so the deployer seeded a PumpSwap pool directly. The LP is 100% unlocked and RugCheck warns of few LP providers. Liquidity ($41k) is larger than market cap ($28k). About $247k of volume went through in 30 minutes, from 1,117 unique buyers against only 116 sellers. GMGN tags 1,000 of 1,114 holders as fresh wallets, plus 33 bundlers. The creator holds 0 and its status is creator_close. There is no website, socials, DexScreener profile or description, and web search found nothing for the contract or the name.
